BC_P.role: registered pi_b_hat (full vocabulary) and reference base (D-1)
BC_P.rows: split==train, logged_label not a sentinel (registered no-pitch descriptions win over a present type; missing or empty type excluded), balls 0-3 and strikes 0-2; no outcome, supported_pa or plate-location condition (policy_requests.bc_population_mask)
BC_P.identification_assumption: MAR: given H, a missing type label is unrelated to the pitch type (S0 counts missing labels by pitcher/count)

BC_E.role: S1 reproduction gate and descriptive TRAIN comparison only; never used for estimation, selection or sensitivity
BC_E.rows: pinned eligible D100 TRAIN keys p4_train_keys

train_bc_plan.history: BC fit keeps state_from_row(bc_only=True) (<UNKNOWN>/<START>); requests use <NO_PITCH>/<MISSING_LABEL>, harmless only because both are sticky refusals (no BC query after them)
train_bc_plan.support_table: bound PolicyInputs.support for every single-hand registry pitcher x batter side {L,R} with the registered hand; AMBIGUOUS pitchers get no row and are refused before the lookup (D-8)
reports: pi_b_hat mass on mask by cell and TRAIN-decision weighted quantiles

hand_registry.rule: train_single_hand_v1: every TRAIN row of the pitcher has the same L/R and none missing, else AMBIGUOUS; no share threshold
hand_registry.artifact: hands.json (pitcheezy.pitcher_hands.v1), pinned in the runtime pins

train_bc_plan.rule_change_after_s1_tables: forbidden: the primary choice is not revisited after the BC_P/BC_E tables
train_bc_plan.bc_p_only_pitcher_rule: evaluate; report as the bc_p_only_pitcher stratum in S6 (D-1 critic 5), fixed before S1

R1_denominator.rule: L0 = every regular-season PA of the window (structurally unsubmittable PAs included); L1 = pre-decision start population E0; supported_pa/eligibility only as descriptive post-hoc layers

R2_decisions.rule: every PA row in pitch_number order; request_id=game:ab:pitch, pa_id=game:ab; a structural defect at row k submits rows 0..k-1 and censors at k

R3_codes.priority: a registered no-pitch description wins over a present type (NO_PITCH); a missing/empty type otherwise -> MISSING_LABEL
R3_codes.adjustment_rule: the no-pitch list may change only from S0 structural counts, never after S4/S6 values

R4_pre_decision.rule: SAFE_COLUMNS of current row plus strictly previous same-PA type/normalized physics/10-class outcome

R4b_profiles.rule: pitcher TRAIN-fixed; batter style C0 frozen at the window start (game_date < as_of_exclusive; DEV 2025-07-01) from all earlier rows, league row (reliability 0) for batters first seen later; S2 probe keeps rolling values

R4c_provenance_checks.rule: history keys/order, whitelist, count path, invariance to post-decision fields
R4c_provenance_checks.implemented: requests: full history, prefix on defects; runtime: count path incl. uncheckable outcomes; snapshot: roster-blind, bit-equal to rolling on the as-of date

R5_reward.rule: structural-end-v1: the PA ended iff its last row has an events code (any, truncated_pa included) AND the adjacent next PA first row is observed (at_bat+1, pitch 1, 0-0, legal transition) or it is the last PA of an officially complete game; r = frozen C0 WE of that pre-pitch state for the initial defender, or the final result; complete_game/post scores missing -> FAILED_INTEGRITY
R5_reward.game_final_rule: game_final_v1: the game's last recorded row has an events code (truncated_pa included), post-pitch scores present and not tied, inning >= 5 (MLB regulation game); replaces data.py complete_game (D-6 critic 3); disagreements with complete_game counted on TRAIN at S0
R5_reward.terminal_placeholder_rule: a last row with an events code and no pitch (registered no-pitch description, or missing type and description) is a state transition: no request; a PA made only of one is NO_DECISION (delta exactly 0, L0 only)

R6_incomplete.bounds: censored node value c in [0,1] inside the D89 recursion: V_0 = base + prod(rho) c; TERMINAL_VALUE_MISSING shares c between policies
R6_incomplete.validity: in expectation when censoring is fixed by H_k or is the shared end value; candidate path needs pi_b_hat correct; LOGGING_POSITIVITY nodes reported as violations

layers.L2: E0 and complete: post-treatment-selected conditional mean, no judgement

R7_mid_pa_change.secondary_estimand: natural course after the first pitcher change (ledger pitcher field; manifest cross-check), descriptive, not in the primary family
R7_mid_pa_change.thresholds_rule: D95: read from the S0 census DEV split when S0 is reviewed and recorded in docs/decisions.md. share_unknown = pa_change_to_pitcher_unseen_in_train / pas (the secondary becomes primary only if share_unknown > switch...above); share_change = pa_with_pitcher_change / pas (the light version only if share_change < light_version_if_below). 1.0 and 0.0 mean: never switch, never light. A large share_unknown goes to a joint <=2025 and 2026 contract change, not an automatic switch

R8_inconsistent_history.rule: count path broken or previous real-pitch outcome uncheckable -> UNSUPPORTED_INCONSISTENT_HISTORY (sticky); ledger index/length/last-type mismatch stays FAILED_INTEGRITY

S0_census.reads: pitch_type, no-pitch flag, pre-pitch fields, identity, at_bat/pitch numbers, 10-class encoding for count paths; events/scores/completion only for TRAIN

S1_materialize.hang_guard_basis: CLAUDE.md D10 local-run ceiling (2 h); a safety timeout, not a cost cap (D-11 D)

S1b_style_snapshot.hang_guard_basis: CLAUDE.md D10 local-run ceiling (2 h); a safety timeout, not a cost cap (D-11 D)

S2_bind_probe.hang_guard_basis: CLAUDE.md D10 local-run ceiling (2 h); a safety timeout, not a cost cap (D-11 D)
S2_bind_probe.row_rule: first 64 mlb_dev rows in pinned order with dev_delivery_level >= 0 in all five member archives
S2_bind_probe.identity_binding: identity.json (components sha256) is registered as bind_identity; S3 and later refuse components with another sha

S3_profile.hang_guard_basis: CLAUDE.md D10 local-run ceiling (2 h); a safety timeout, not a cost cap (D-11 D)
S3_profile.candidates_note: list of {samples, pitch_cap}; every candidate is measured on the same starts (rows are not assumed to scale with pitch_cap)
S3_profile.evaluation_seed_in_cost: every candidate runs with the evaluation-seed search; planning rows select the setting (S3b runs no evaluator), evaluator-inclusive rows feed the M-7 rule

S3b_tau_select.hang_guard_basis: CLAUDE.md D10 local-run ceiling (2 h); a safety timeout, not a cost cap (D-11 D)
S3b_tau_select.rule: smallest tau passing both-policy overlap, the candidate/reference ESS ratio and the paired-difference noise ratio; reference failing -> ARM_B_NOT_EVALUABLE; none -> P3_NOT_EVALUABLE; grid never widened
S3b_tau_select.reads: pre-decision fields, logged types, previous-row outcomes (history), terminal-marker presence only; no WE, reward, events kind or next-row state
S3b_tau_select.exposure_note: June 2025 exposed_policy_tuning reused for G0 P3 tau design without outcomes
S3b_tau_select.determinism_check_basis: D-9 note 5: rebuild with the selected tau and reproduce the planning Q of the first 2 E0 PAs within S2 atol_primary (design constant, cost-only)

S4_V5_denominators.hang_guard_basis: CLAUDE.md D10 local-run ceiling (2 h); a safety timeout, not a cost cap (D-11 D)
S4_V5_denominators.seal: handled PAs == pinned S0 census dev pas; ledger decision rows == submitted requests

S5_V2_V3.starts_rule: every E0 PA start of M-1 selected DEV games (salted hash, month-proportional, straddling games excluded)
S5_V2_V3.q_hat: same as S6 (evaluation seed when registered)
S5_V2_V3.censor_hazard_check: optional: {action: probability} hazard with replicates; records the share of replicates whose L1 bounds and endpoint CIs contain the truth (D-5 critic 5); not part of acceptance

S6_V4.paired_identity_run: independent cand=ref runtime on the same requests; every complete PA delta exactly 0 and equal complete sets (M-10, D89 V4 e); failure fails S6
S6_V4.dr_q_rule: M-7, applied mechanically at S3b: the DR q-hat uses the evaluation seed unless the S3-measured evaluator-inclusive rows per decision of the chosen setting x planned_decisions exceed row_budget (then planning-Q reuse); the result enters the frozen identity and S5/S6 follow it
S6_V4.d7_diagnostic: before any reward: G0 10-class TV/KL and batter soft-membership TV, frozen vs rolling priors, on the first d7_diagnostic_starts E0 starts
